items.title: verify-merge heavy-gate classifier and compile-once optimization
items.context: scripts/verify-merge-needed.sh classifies a diff via ci-classify-changes.sh and reports whether it would trigger CI's heavy Linux build/test gate without running the full merge gate; scripts/verify-merge.sh runs the same classifier for context, installs once, builds the web host only when stale, compiles test artifacts once and reuses the compiled output for test:unit/test:packages, and gates native package tests behind the same portability classification CI uses, while preserving every pre-existing required step (validate-pack, workspace/extension coverage, the pi-ai vitest suite, integration, e2e). Also documents the new advisory script in CONTRIBUTING.md and two docs/dev guides, and adds scripts/__tests__/verify-merge.test.mjs. 2026-08-24: rebased onto upstream/main (base e28218e4, up from the original 91-commits-behind base 4bbfb31f) after fast-forwarding fork main; hit a REAL merge conflict with an unrelated upstream fix (#1582/#1883, building the native test-fault-injection addon on a fresh checkout, gated behind a rustc check) that landed on the same lines this branch touches. Resolved by combining both: classify step runs first, then the native-addon build/Rust-check, then install, preserving the addon-staging step (mkdir/cp/export GSD_NATIVE_PREFER_LOCAL) before test:unit:compiled. Verified via git range-diff and rev-list --left-right --count (0 1). Cross-AI reviewed with `codex review --commit` (codex-cli 0.145.0, using its own tool access to inspect build-web-if-stale.cjs and ci-classify-changes.sh) and an independent Claude Opus 4.6 subagent pass; both found real, non-overlapping issues, which were fixed and folded into the commit via amend: (1) verify-merge-needed.sh now guards --base/--head against a missing value instead of an unbound-variable crash, (2) verify-merge-needed.sh now warns (not fails) when the working tree has uncommitted/untracked changes, since its classification is diff-based and can't see them, (3) added 4 new behavioral tests for both fixes (10/10 pass locally). Two additional codex findings were verified accurate but deliberately NOT fixed here (out of scope, pre-existing bugs in files this branch doesn't own): build-web-if-stale.cjs's mtime-based staleness check doesn't cover packages/*, the lockfile, or scripts/stage-web-standalone.cjs, so it can under-rebuild; ci-classify-changes.sh silently falls back to `HEAD~1` if BASE/HEAD don't resolve, which can under-classify a multi-commit diff on a shallow/misconfigured checkout. Both are noted in a comment in verify-merge-needed.sh and should get their own dedicated fix later.
items.validation: Local: bash -n syntax-checked all scripts; node --test scripts/__tests__/verify-merge.test.mjs passed 12/12 (10 from the review round plus 2 more for the exit-128 fail-safe fix). Remote: pimmink/gsd-pi-ci run 32727696891 (against 4d2eecd6, pre-fail-safe-fix) reproduced a REAL, live exit-128 crash in verify-merge (literal): the new classify step's ci-classify-changes.sh call failed because its own base-ref resolution AND its HEAD~1 fallback both failed on the harness's shallow/minimal checkout ('fatal: ambiguous argument HEAD~1: unknown revision'). Fixed by wrapping the classify call in both scripts so a non-zero exit or empty output defaults every gate to the safe/heavy path instead of crashing or silently skipping coverage. Redispatched against the fixed commit a64a26db: run 32728995515 came back fully GREEN -- verify-pr (literal) success in 19m41s, verify-merge (literal) success in 33m36s. This is the submission-grade exact-SHA evidence, and it caught a real bug the earlier local-only review passes (codex, Claude Opus 4.6 subagent) did not exercise.
items.nextAction: PR opened: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-pi/pull/1990 (Ready for review, base main). Monitor for maintainer feedback. Two pre-existing, deliberately out-of-scope issues (build-web-if-stale.cjs staleness gaps, ci-classify-changes.sh's HEAD~1 fallback) are noted in the PR description and in verify-merge-needed.sh's own header comment for anyone picking them up later.

items.title: Cheaper same-tier Copilot suggestions in pricing/why
items.context: Separate follow-up feature branch, rebuilt on top of the confirmed-green GSD-W018 tip (886c4b41c3db3cb244de4ea6215c9f0771230b1d, itself rebased for the fourth time after a fourth upstream drift). Adds explicit cheaper same-tier GitHub Copilot suggestions to /gsd copilot-models pricing and why output, plus the proactive notification feature in copilot-catalog-notifications.ts (fires a non-blocking, deduplicated notification on manual model selection/cycling or after a GSD-W018 session-start refresh, distinguishing cheaper-equivalent from better-and-cheaper messaging via a pure capability-score comparison, never fabricating data, never altering routing or switching the active model). upstream/main advanced a FOURTH time; W014 and W018 were both rebased a fourth time and this branch was rebased onto the new W018 tip via `git rebase --onto`; git range-diff confirmed the single commit content-identical. 2026-08-24 fifth rebase onto GSD-W018's updated tip 91787bcd. Unlike prior rebases, this one produced a real conflict in copilot-models.ts (8 hunks) because GSD-W014's codex-round fixes changed the same functions (localCopilotModels, findLocalModel, resolveEconomicsForModel, formatPricingRecord) that GSD-W017's own commit also touches — resolved by combining both sides: kept the Model<Api>/ExtensionCommandContext type-safety from GSD-W014 while preserving GSD-W017's new parameters/call sites (cheaperSameTierOption, snapshot). Rebase also silently broke 2 call sites inside findCheaperSameTierOption that called resolveEconomicsForModel with GSD-W014's *old* 3-argument signature (no ctx) without a git conflict marker (wholly-new hunk, nothing to conflict with) — caught by tsc, not by the merge itself. Fixing that then surfaced a genuine type mismatch: findCheaperSameTierOption only ever has ExtensionContext (it's invoked from the model_select hook, not a command handler), so it cannot pass ctx into a parameter typed ExtensionCommandContext — relaxed readGithubCopilotModelsJsonCost/buildUserOverrideEconomics/resolveEconomicsForModel's ctx parameter to ExtensionContext (they only touch ctx.modelRegistry, unchanged on the narrower type, so every existing caller stays valid). Full-suite verification after the rebase then surfaced two PRE-EXISTING test-fixture bugs, confirmed present even on the original pre-rebase commit da4f2b44 (checked out from recovery/w017-pre-rebase5-20260824 for comparison): (1) copilot-models-handler.test.ts's two cheaper-same-tier tests set Model<Api>.cost in $-per-1K units instead of the actual $-per-1M convention (tokenPricesFromCost divides by 1000), so they were silently relying on the bare-ID BUNDLED_COST_TABLE implicit fallback instead of the fixture's own intended cost, and broke once GSD-W014's disableImplicitFallback: true was inherited; (2) copilot-catalog-notifications.test.ts's createFakeCtx never supplied any cost data at all, so 5 of its 10 tests were failing (via early-return false, no exception) even before this rebase. Both fixed with correctly-scaled explicit cost fixtures.

items.title: Session-start GitHub Copilot catalog refresh and runtime model activation
items.context: Separate follow-up feature branch stacked on the W014 tip (W014 is not yet merged upstream). Adds an opt-in automatic refresh of the GitHub Copilot live model catalog at GSD session start, gated by a new copilot_catalog preference block (refresh_on_session_start: off|if_stale|always, default off; notify_on_changes default true; stale_after_ms default 6h). The coordinator reuses W014's existing fetch/last-known-good pipeline rather than duplicating it, is fire-and-forget only (never blocks ordinary startup), deduplicates concurrent triggers per basePath, applies a bounded timeout, and never triggers or waits on an OAuth/login flow. Also implements 3-tier runtime model classification (trusted / manual-only / quarantined) directly from the live CopilotModelRecord's availability/execution/billing/conflicts fields, without fabricating capability or pricing data. Wired into the session_start extension hook only. upstream/main advanced a FOURTH time (60f6919 -> c84f72b79f0bad21002be8d0988a912056e204a6), so W014 was rebased a fourth time and this branch was rebased onto the new W014 tip via `git rebase --onto`; git range-diff confirmed both feature commits content-identical again. 2026-08-24 fifth rebase onto GSD-W014's updated tip c6e108ea (cosmetic lint-cleanup commit, no functional changes) — clean rebase, zero conflicts. While rebased, fixed copilot-catalog-session-refresh.ts's own instance of the cross-provider price-bleed bug already fixed for copilot-models.ts on PR #1978 (independent codex review, round 1): classifyRemoteCopilotModel's resolveModelEconomics call passed an explicit fallbackEconomics object with no tokenPrices, so resolveModelEconomics still merged in its own bare-model-ID implicit bundled-fallback lookup for the missing field, meaning a same-named model priced by a different provider could silently be reported as this Copilot model's known price. Added disableImplicitFallback: true (the same opt-in flag added to model-cost-table.ts during GSD-W014's codex round 1) to close it.

items.title: Repair evidence-backed lifecycle shadow authority before Milestone validation
items.context: Adopted Milestones could contain legacy-complete Tasks or Slices with durable completion evidence but no workflow_item_lifecycles authority, causing strict closeout validation to fail with missing canonical lifecycle authority. The fix adds a narrow evidence-gated forward repair before validation, preserving strict Milestone completion guards. Post-review found two additional stop-ship gaps in the original bb75b2f9 patch: (1) taskCompletionFacts() accepted any non-empty verification_result instead of requiring an exact passed verdict; (2) repairMilestoneLifecycleShadowsForward() committed each repairable descendant as its own separate Domain Operation while iterating, so a later unresolved sibling did not roll back earlier already-committed repairs.
items.validation: Both gaps fixed with test-first regression coverage: e7cb339e adds isPassingVerificationResult() (trim+lowercase equality) with normalized-passing and rejected-non-passing variant tests. 4061bc41 adds an execution-based reproduction of the partial-write atomicity gap. 4fff9598 makes the milestone repair all-or-nothing: a read-only planning pass classifies every descendant first; if any in-scope descendant is unresolved, nothing is written; otherwise single-step repairs commit together in one shared lifecycle.shadow.repair Domain Operation, and two-phase ready-Task advance+complete sequences (a pre-existing, unrelated schema invariant requiring two separately committed operations) run only after the planning pass has confirmed no sibling is unresolved. 71/71 focused tests pass across lifecycle-shadow-forward-repair.test.ts and milestone-validation-domain-operation.test.ts. tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.extensions.json passed. pnpm run build:core passed. scripts/ci-fast-gates.sh passed (222/222 tests + strict test-gap/test-matrix audits). gate:lifecycle-shadow-no-cutover passed (7/7 structural, 11/11 behavioral). Local test:unit:compiled (the full ~1800-file monorepo suite) was too slow on this machine and was moved to remote CI instead. Remote full gate run 32947426378 completed successfully: verify-pr and verify-merge both passed on GitHub-hosted runners.

All GitHub checks passing (8 SUCCESS, 1 SKIPPED: fast-gates, contract-tests, build, node22-smoke, ci-gate, GitGuardian, Socket Security). Awaiting maintainer review/approval.

items.title: Agent-core resolved tool result isError flag dropped in the agent loop
items.context: A normally resolved tool result carrying isError: true is re-wrapped by the agent loop as isError: false, silently discarding a caller's error signal. The native MCP adapter already preserves the MCP error flag and the external Claude adapter already preserves externalResult.isError; the loss is in the shared pi-agent-core execution path. Because AgentToolResult currently documents throw-on-failure and does not declare isError, preserving the field in core would add a public error-signaling contract.
items.validation: Reproduction added locally in packages/pi-agent-core/test/agent-loop.test.ts on branch fix/agent-core-tool-result-iserror (based on upstream/main 327343af): a tool resolving with { content, details, isError: true } currently emits tool_execution_end.isError=false, so the focused test fails exactly at that assertion. The test dependency setup required pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm --filter @gsd/pi-ai run build; git diff --check is clean. No production code changed. Upstream CONTRIBUTING.md requires an RFC and maintainer approval before changes touching agent-core; no issue or approval is recorded yet.
items.nextAction: RFC issue #2015 and Draft PR #2016 are open. Await maintainer approval for the proposed AgentToolResult.isError contract (or agreement on an adapter-only alternative); then implement the smallest approved shared-loop fix, extend the regression to ToolResultMessage, and run the required verification ladder before marking the PR ready.

localExtensionPatches.reimplementationNote: Independent, scoped-down reimplementation for personal use, not a copy of the PR diffs. Community extensions cannot modify gsd's own core files that these PRs touch (model-router.ts, preferences-types.ts, bootstrap/register-hooks.ts), so this only adds new commands/hooks via the public ExtensionAPI. Provides read-only catalog viewing (/copilot-catalog [all|pricing|why]) plus a best-effort, at-most-hourly session-start new/removed-model notification. Deliberately omits automatic model registration into gsd's provider config and automatic cheaper-model-switch notifications tied to gsd's internal before_model_select task-classification/routing system -- both were judged too risky to reimplement without the real PRs' tested logic. Verified working end-to-end 2026-08-24 from the Edelman_Studio project: session_start hook fetched the live Copilot catalog (56 models) and wrote it to ~/.gsd/agent/extensions/copilot-catalog-patch/.catalog-cache.json. 2026-08-24 re-sync check: reviewed every commit added to the 3 branches since the previous recorded heads (9c84c780/886c4b41/da4f2b44), including the GitHub-Copilot-automated-review fixes, 2 codex review rounds, the account-isolation fix, the cross-provider price-bleed fix (disableImplicitFallback), and the lint-cleanup commit. None apply to this extension: index.ts always fetches the live /models catalog fresh on every command invocation (no cached last-known-good snapshot, no per-account session state, no BUNDLED_COST_TABLE bare-ID lookup, no models.json cost-override resolution) -- the entire bug class this session fixed (stale/cross-provider/wrong-account data reuse) does not exist in this simpler, always-live-fetch design. No index.ts change made. 2026-08-24 re-sync check #2: reviewed the 7 new GitHub-Copilot-review-driven fixes in commit 7595ba0a (missing Copilot client-identity headers on /models, input_cost_per_token/output_cost_per_token pricing parsing, account-key stable-source fingerprinting, deferred snapshot commit, transition-keyed notification dedup, routing-eligibility/caveats split, cross-provider cost threading, rejection-reason comparator mirroring). None apply: index.ts already sends the same Copilot client-identity headers (COPILOT_HEADERS, unchanged since this extension was written), never computes cost-table pricing at all (pricing mode just sorts by the raw API multiplier field), has no per-account session state or account-key fingerprinting (loadCatalog() always fetches fresh), and its session_start cache-diff (comparing only against the single most recent .catalog-cache.json, not a permanent ever-growing set) is structurally immune to the notification-dedup bug since a re-added model naturally re-diffs as added again. No index.ts change needed. 2026-08-24 re-sync check #3: reviewed commit 4b5be82f (fixes 2 regressions a follow-up codex review found in 7595ba0a's own account-key and notification-dedup fixes: unstored-credential account keys now also fold in modelRegistry.modelsJsonPath to distinguish projects sharing a process, and notification dedup now compares against only the immediately-preceding shown content instead of a permanent transition-hash set). Neither applies: index.ts has no account-key concept at all (loadCatalog() always fetches fresh, no per-account fingerprinting to collide across projects), and its session_start cache-diff already only compares against the single most recent .catalog-cache.json, never a permanent set, so the transition-hash-collision/register-suppression bug class doesn't exist here either. No index.ts change needed. 2026-08-24 bug found+fixed (unrelated to upstream PR sync, in this extension's own code): getArgumentCompletions returned raw strings (['all','pricing','why']) instead of {value,label} objects; gsd-pi's SelectList.getDisplayValue() does item.label || item.value, which is undefined on a bare string, and the resulting undefined gets passed to visibleWidth() during the very first render of the suggestion popup -- crashed the TUI (dropped to a raw shell with leaked escape-sequence garbage) every time a user typed "/copilot-catalog " (trailing space) to see subcommand suggestions. Reproduced live in Edelman_Studio 2026-08-24. Fixed by returning properly-shaped {value, label, description} objects filtered by the typed prefix, matching the real PR's filterOptions()/getGsdArgumentCompletions() convention (src/resources/extensions/gsd/commands/catalog.ts). Bumped extension-manifest.json version 0.2.0 -> 0.2.1. Verified: `node --experimental-strip-types --check index.ts` passes; awaiting live re-test in Edelman_Studio.
localExtensionPatches.knownIssue: On gsd-pi <=1.16.0, this directory-based global extension was silently destroyed on EVERY gsd session start: pruneRemovedBundledExtensions() in src/resource-loader.ts runs a 'sweep' step that rmSync()s (recursive, force) any subdirectory under ~/.gsd/agent/extensions/ whose name isn't part of gsd's own currently-bundled extension set, with no exclusion for community-tier manifests. Reproduced 2026-08-24 with a trivial, harmless test extension (no filesystem code of its own) -- gsd itself deleted the whole directory after one `gsd --print` session, silently (all wrapped in try/catch, no stderr). `gsd --version` alone did not trigger it (exits before initResources()); any full session-starting invocation did. Temporarily worked around via project-local .gsd/extensions/<name>.js (ecosystem/loader.ts has no prune/sweep logic), installed only in Edelman_Studio. CONFIRMED FIXED in 1.16.1 (upgraded global install from 1.16.0 -> 1.16.1 on 2026-08-24 via `npm install -g @opengsd/gsd-pi@latest`; re-tested the exact same reproduction with a fresh dummy extension and it survived a full gsd --print session). Reverted to the documented global location as the sole install afterward and removed the project-local workaround. requires.platform is now set to >=1.16.1 so this manifest self-documents the minimum safe version. Still plausibly worth an upstream bug report so gsd-pi's own manifest-spec.md / building-extensions.md Quick Start docs (or the sweep logic itself, for anyone still on <=1.16.0) reflect this -- NOT filed, needs explicit authorization first per contributor governance.
